title: 1951 KOREAN WAR HOME MOVIE PUSAN WEST AIR BASE BURIAL DETAIL MARINE CORPS (SILENT) 24114
summary: This graphic Korean War era (1950-1953) reel of raw footage, filmed by a US serviceman, documents operations of UN Intervention force and the US Marines in Korea, near Pusan and Masan. It features the U.S. Marines VMAT-502 / Attack Squadron 513 at their airbase, handling of North Korean POWs, and the work of the local Korean people to bury the bodies of the dead at a temporary UN cemetery at Masan
